decisions.reason: The multi-model operator line is central to the garage door business and complements every door sold, so after four years it has turned from an option into a core product worth keeping.
The solid wood sectional door is a niche with uncertain demand and no visible results for 2020 to 2021, but it costs little to keep within configurable production and supports the one-source range.
The remote-control operator is cheap to keep and complements the garage range, though it is at risk of being folded into the broader operator line Product A.

This glazed industrial door overlaps with Product F, and with no visible results for 2020 to 2021 its value is still unclear, but it costs little to keep in configurable production, so the option stays open for now.
Its own-page presentation marks it as the main glazed industrial door, and after E was dropped it remains the variant the firm has committed to.
